After the renegade [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] was [[Escape from the Spire/Legends|liberated]] from a remote [[Spire (Stygeon Prime)/Legends|Separatist prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stygeon/Legends|Stygeon]], Maul and his [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] forces were followed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]], where the two groups engaged in a '''battle'''.<ref name="SonOfDathomir1" />
{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The battle on Zanbar appeared in the [[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir|Darth Maul—Son of Dathomir]]'' comic series, written by [[Jeremy Barlow]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="SonOfDathomir1" /> on [[May 21]], [[2014]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/24-765/Star-Wars-Darth-Maul-Son-of-Dathomir-1|text=Star Wars: Darth Maul&mdash;Son of Dathomir #1}}</ref>
